name: Seven Card Stud
tagline: No board: four of your seven cards are face up for all to read.
rulesSummary: Win everyone's chips. Run out and you're out; the last player with chips wins.
Everyone antes and gets two cards face down and one face up. The lowest card showing (aces high; ties ♣, ♦, ♥, ♠ from lowest) must bring it in for half the smallest bet.
The others may fold, call the bring-in, or complete it to the smallest bet or more. No limit: bet up to all your chips.
Fourth, fifth and sixth street: one more card face up each, then betting. Seventh street: a last card face down and a final round.
From fourth street, the best hand showing bets first (pairs and trips count; straights and flushes don't). Ties: nearest the dealer's left.
Best to worst: straight flush, four of a kind, full house, flush, straight, three of a kind, two pair, pair, high card. Aces are high, or low in A-2-3-4-5.
The best five of your seven cards wins the pot. Ties split it.
